keys.key: src/seeds/contacts.seed.ts:66-70 · seedContacts · the idempotency check uses deletedAt: { $exists: false }, which misses contacts that carry an explicit deletedAt: null (imported ones), so a re-run creates duplicates
src/seeds/pro-microsites.seed.ts:63-89 · seedProMicrosites · the slug-taken skip is gone, so a slug held by another account makes create() throw a duplicate-key error and aborts the whole seed run
src/modules/contacts/contacts.repo.ts:50 · listPaginated · a whitespace-only search passes the truthiness check, the word list filters to empty, and an empty $and makes MongoDB reject the query

src/seeds/journey-invitations.seed.ts:87 · seedJourneyInvitations · journeys are listed across all owners (first 100) instead of the consumer's, so the invitation can attach to another owner's journey with the same template key

findings.effect: The seeder only checks for an existing pending invitation and bypasses the create flow's check that the professional is not already a participant. It can create a fresh pending invitation after nikki accepts or declines the original, including an invitation to a journey she has already joined.
findings.reason: The new seeder checks only pending invitations and creates directly through the repository, allowing another invitation after acceptance even when the professional already participates.

findings.effect: The invitation seeder looks up the sender's consumer profile but never uses it, instead taking the first journey with the matching template from an unfiltered page of 100 journeys. A local database with other matching journeys or more than 100 journeys could attach the invitation to the wrong owner's journey or find none.
findings.reason: It names the seed file within 10 lines of line 87 and describes how the unfiltered journey lookup can select another owner's journey.

findings.effect: The invitation seeder selects the first journey with the matching template key without checking its owner. If a second journey has that key, the invitation could land on a journey where ricardo is not a participant.
findings.reason: It points to line 88 in the seed file and identifies the missing ownership check that can attach the invitation to another owner's journey.

findings.effect: A whitespace-only search produces an empty word list and sets filter.$and to an empty array, which MongoDB rejects. Current callers trim and require a minimum length, but a future caller that skips that validation could trigger the failure.
findings.reason: It names the repository file near line 50 and correctly describes whitespace-only search producing an empty $and that MongoDB rejects.
